cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've advanced the charity our estimated auction takings. Now we just need bidders.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You borrowed five thousand. Only your mum registered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. One bidder keeps catering costs down. That's responsible fundraising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum's only coming to give us a lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must bid ourselves. Raise the card limit; protecting that donation has to come first.

mechanism: A uses supposedly expert fundraising accounting to sell borrowing and self-bidding as the responsible way to protect a promised donation.
confusable: Simple self-deception need not persuade a partner; A must recast B accurate debt concerns as amateur misclassification and demand further commitment.
comparison: Roof alternative uses operating-cost distortions; auction alternative compounds a sunk financial obligation.
seedUse: Advance, sole attendee and self-bidding derive from D17-b; S03 adds corrective accounting distinctions rather than a generic professional preface.
